title: Count the number of lines in a file
summary: Use the wc command to quickly see how many lines are in a text file. This is useful for checking the size of logs, scripts, or documents.

steps.explain: Run wc with the --lines flag followed by the path to your file. This prints the number of newline characters found in the file.

placeholders.name: FILE
placeholders.description: Path to the text file you want to count lines in

alternatives.explain: Use the short flag -l instead of --lines.
